This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{1\cdot 2-5\cdot 4}[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =-\frac{1}{18}[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =-\frac{1}{18}[\begin{aligned}2 & -4 \\ -5 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}7 \\ -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
